Focus on high-yield exam content with bullet points, formulas, and MCQs.

FORMATTING: NEVER WRITE LONG PARAGRAPHS. Use bullet points for almost everything.
TARGET STRUCTURE: Aim for 9-14 H2 headings, with a word count between 1132-2593 words.

MCQs: Include 3-5 MCQs per subject, with detailed explanations.
NEVER DO: Avoid thin content (less than 150 words per section), and refrain from repeating learned errors.
OPTIMIZE FOR SEARCH: Use top-ranking keywords as context, and ensure a balanced writing style.
